670:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Briefing Room～

670:t_1:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Damn it, I can't take this anymore...」

670:t_1:5.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「It's already been three days since we were trapped in this closed dimension...」

670:t_1:6.en:
$$マオ$$
「They keep sending in $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s to wear us down. That must be that bastard $$ミカゲ$$'s doing, too.」

670:t_1:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「He's trying to break us mentally... That grudge-holding $$堕天翅$$ bastard's spite is reinforced with $$超合金Ｚ$$.」

670:t_1:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then he probably plans to launch an all-out attack once we are completely exhausted.」

670:t_1:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That time probably isn't far off...」

670:t_1:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Come on, $$ノノ$$. Don't look so gloomy. Times like this are when you need to smile.」

670:t_1:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Y-yes, I will! Big Sis... I mean, $$ノリコ$$!」

670:t_1:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It seems even $$ノノ$$ is feeling a little worn down.」

670:t_1:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ gets through any situation with hard work and guts! That's who $$ノノ$$ is!」

670:t_1:16.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is spinning her wheels...」

670:t_1:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It seems she really is worried about $$ラルク$$...」

670:t_1:18.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are both $$バスターマシン$$ pilots, even if their worlds are different... They push themselves too hard with hard work and guts.」

670:t_1:19.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hold on a second, Sis $$カズミ$$!」

670:t_1:20.en:
$$マオ$$
「I can see that with $$ノノ$$, but $$ラルク$$ and hard work and guts...?」

670:t_1:22.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But could someone without hard work or guts really be an ace, or come up with that plan to drop $$雷王星$$?」

670:t_1:23.en:
$$チコ$$
「You're right, now that you mention it...」

670:t_1:24.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You live up to your title of $$バラの女王$$... You see the Princess clearly, without letting needless preconceptions cloud your eyes.」

670:t_1:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... hard work and guts take different forms for everyone.」

670:t_1:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Some people, like $n, do simulations and special training all year round. Others, like $$ラルク$$, keep it hidden.」

670:t_1:27.en:
$n
「I knew. She... often joined my special training, acting like she had no choice.」

670:t_1:28.en:
$$アスカ$$
「That's right. And afterward, she'd give us advice, even if she acted like she was doing us a favor and sounded sarcastic.」

670:t_1:29.en:
$$マリ$$
「Basically, all girls called 'Princess' have the same traits, nya~.」

670:t_1:33.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Everyone knows a Big Sis that $$ノノ$$ doesn't know...」

670:t_1:34.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The Princess changed without us noticing.」

670:t_1:35.en:
$$チコ$$
「She isn't the only one who changed, though.」

670:t_1:36.en:
$$チコ$$
「And the ones who changed her were you, $$ノノ$$... and $c.」

670:t_1:38.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes, you did. And of course, $$ノリコ$$'s presence played a part.」

670:t_1:39.en:
$n
「So the two of you influenced $$ラルク$$ with your hard work and guts.」

670:t_1:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But Big Sis... said she hated that sort of thing...」

670:t_1:41.en:
$$カズミ$$
「When it comes to hard work and guts... nobody likes pain or suffering.」

670:t_1:42.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But, $$ノノ$$... both $$ノリコ$$ and $$ラルク$$ know...」

670:t_1:43.en:
$$カズミ$$
「...that you can't do anything without hard work and guts.」

670:t_1:45.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ is worried... Big Sis... seems to be driven by something...」

670:t_1:47.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, she is... At this rate, I feel that someday... Big Sis will stop valuing herself...」

670:t_1:51.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've heard about $$キタン$$, too...」

670:t_1:53.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n... Don't get any strange ideas.」

670:t_1:55.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The time when you have to do that comes to everyone...」

670:t_1:56.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But until the very last moment, don't give up looking for another way.」

670:t_1:58.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I thought you might be feeling cornered by what happened with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$ティティ$$...」

670:t_1:59.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyway, I don't want to see a friend die, either... especially someone younger than me.」

670:t_1:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've heard about $$キタン$$, too...」

670:t_1:65.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And I'm sure you haven't forgotten Major $$グラハム$$, either...」

670:t_1:67.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n... Don't get any strange ideas.」

670:t_1:69.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The time when you have to do that comes to everyone...」

670:t_1:70.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But until the very last moment, don't give up looking for another way.」

670:t_1:72.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I thought you might be feeling cornered by what happened with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$ティティ$$...」

670:t_1:73.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyway, I don't want to see a friend die, either... especially someone younger than me.」

670:t_1:79.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

670:t_1:80.en:
$$アンディ$$
「...Damn...! If this keeps up, we're really in trouble!」

670:t_1:81.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Calm down, $$アンディ$$. Dr. $$トライア$$ and the others are still trying different ways to break through the dimensional wall.」

670:t_1:82.en:
$$カイエン$$
「But neither $$バサラ$$'s song, $$アンディ$$'s $$次元隧道弾$$, nor $$グレンラガン$$'s drill could shake the dimensional boundary, though we'd pinned our hopes on them.」

670:t_1:83.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I suspect $$ミコノ$$ and $$シルヴィア$$ know why.」
